`[[ ${BATS_TEST_NAME-} == $* ]]` leaves the right side unquoted, so it is a glob match instead of a literal comparison. If a test function name or command contains `*` or `?`, or a pattern like `test_*` is registered, several entries can match the selected name. They then overwrite BATS_TEST_TAGS, BATS_TEST_DESCRIPTION and BATS_TEST_COMMAND with the wrong test's values.
